summary: Take your digital marketing skills to the next level with our specialized training. Dominate the online world with effective strategies and targeted advertising
lede: Digital marketing strategy brings search, content, paid media and social activity into a plan tied to customer journeys and measurable objectives. For professionals planning or managing multi-channel campaigns, this course develops practical skills in market and competitor analysis, KPI setting, campaign design, and performance measurement. Learners practice building analytics dashboards, structuring search and paid social campaigns, and mapping automated lead-nurturing workflows.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the planning, execution, or oversight of digital growth initiatives within their organizations.
audience: Performance Marketing Specialists focused on ROAS
modules: Digital Strategy Frameworks and Market Analysis
Data Analytics and Measurement with GA4
Search Engine Optimization and Content Strategy
Search Engine Marketing and Google Ads
Paid Social Media and Audience Targeting
Integrated Media Planning and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of marketing principles and at least 6 months of experience managing or contributing to digital channels. No coding knowledge is required, though familiarity with social media platforms and basic spreadsheet functions is expected.
